title: 工作介绍与经验描述
html:
工作介绍与经验描述

概述

本章解决"如何用英语介绍工作"这一问题，涵盖职位与职责、工作经验、面试常用表达、行业与公司四个子场景。无论是自我介绍、简历措辞还是面试问答，核心都是准确说明自己做什么、做过什么、擅长什么。每个子场景配有听说例句与写作表达，方便读者在对话和书面材料两种场合灵活取用。建议按"职位—经验—表达—行业"的顺序学习，先打好词汇基础，再套用高频句式组织成完整表述。

职位与职责

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
position n. 职位 current position, apply for a position
responsibility n. 职责 key responsibility, take responsibility
duty n. 义务/职责 daily duties, on duty
role n. 角色 play a role, key role
assignment n. 任务/分配 work assignment, complete the assignment
promotion n. 晋升 get a promotion, promotion opportunity

听说例句

A: What's your current position? B: I'm a senior software engineer. My main responsibility is building and maintaining our backend services.

A: Have you taken on any new duties recently? B: Yes, I've been assigned to lead the migration project. It's a great opportunity for growth.

写作表达

  • In my current role, I am responsible for overseeing the development lifecycle of three core products.
  • The position requires strong communication skills and hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure.

工作经验

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
experience n. 经验 hands-on experience, work experience
expertise n. 专业知识 technical expertise, domain expertise
background n. 背景 professional background, educational background
achievement n. 成就 key achievement, notable achievement
accomplishment n. 成就 major accomplishment, career accomplishment
qualification n. 资质 required qualification, professional qualification

听说例句

A: Can you tell me about your professional background? B: I have five years of experience in full-stack development, with expertise in React and Node.js.

A: What would you consider your biggest achievement? B: Leading a team that reduced system downtime by 40% through automated monitoring.

写作表达

  • With over eight years of hands-on experience in data engineering, I bring deep expertise in building scalable data pipelines.
  • His notable achievements include launching two products that reached over one million active users.

面试常用表达

表达 含义 场景
I'm passionate about... 我对...充满热情 表达兴趣
I thrive in... environments 我在...环境中表现出色 描述适应性
I have a proven track record of... 我有...的成功记录 展示成就
I'm looking for an opportunity to... 我在寻找...的机会 表达求职动机
I'm a quick learner and... 我学得快，而且... 强调学习能力
My strengths lie in... 我的优势在于... 总结优势

听说例句

A: Why are you interested in this role? B: I'm passionate about building user-facing products. I'm looking for an opportunity to combine my frontend skills with product thinking.

A: What are your strengths? B: My strengths lie in cross-team collaboration and turning ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans.

写作表达

  • I have a proven track record of delivering high-quality software on tight schedules.
  • I thrive in fast-paced environments where collaboration and innovation are valued.

行业与公司

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
industry n. 行业 tech industry, industry trends
startup n. 初创公司 join a startup, startup culture
corporation n. 大公司 multinational corporation, corporate culture
headquarters n. 总部 company headquarters, global headquarters
subsidiary n. 子公司 wholly-owned subsidiary, overseas subsidiary
competitor n. 竞争对手 main competitor, market competitor

听说例句

A: What kind of company do you work for? B: It's a mid-size startup in the e-commerce industry. We're growing fast and expanding globally.

A: Who are your main competitors? B: Our primary competitors are two multinational corporations, but we differentiate through better user experience.

写作表达

  • The company has established subsidiaries in five countries, with its headquarters based in Singapore.
  • Keeping up with industry trends is essential for maintaining a competitive edge in the market.
